title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2604.25850v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Harnesses are now central to coding-agent performance, mediating how models interact with tools and execution environments. Yet harness engineering remains a manual craft, because automating it faces a heterogeneous action space across editable components, voluminous trajectories that bury actionable signal, and edits whose effect is hard to attribute. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE), a closed loop that addresses these challenges through three matched observability pillars: (1) component observability gives every editable harness component a file-level representation so the action space is explicit and revertible; (2) experience observability distills millions of raw trajectory tokens into a layered, drill-down evidence corpus that an evolving agent can actually consume; and (3) decision observability pairs every edit with a self-declared prediction, later verified against the next round's task-level outcomes. Together

translated_title: 智能体框架工程：基于可观测性的编码智能体框架自动演化
translated_abstract: 框架目前已成为编码智能体性能的核心，它调节着模型与工具及执行环境之间的交互方式。然而，框架工程仍然是一门依赖人工的手艺，因为将其自动化面临诸多挑战：跨可编辑组件的异构行动空间、淹没可操作信号的海量轨迹，以及效果难以归因的编辑。我们提出了智能体框架工程，这是一个闭环系统，通过三大相互匹配的可观测性支柱来应对这些挑战：(1) 组件可观测性为每个可编辑的框架组件提供文件级表示，使行动空间显式且可回滚；(2) 经验可观测性将数百万原始轨迹标记提炼为分层、可下钻的证据语料库，供演化智能体实际消费使用；(3) 决策可观测性为每次编辑配备一个自主声明的预测，并在下一轮任务级结果中对其进行验证。
tldr: 该论文提出智能体框架工程（AHE）闭环系统，通过组件、经验和决策三大可观测性支柱，首次实现了编码智能体框架的自动化演化，解决了行动空间异构、轨迹信号淹没和编辑效果难归因三大挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE), a closed-loop system that enables automatic evolution of coding-agent harnesses through three observability pillars—component, experience, and decision observability—to overcome heterogeneous action spaces, signal-buried trajectories, and hard-to-attribute edits.
